Subject: Apology for My Mistake  

Hi [Colleague's Name],  

I’m sorry for [briefly describe mistake]. It was unprofessional and I understand it caused inconvenience. I take full responsibility and will ensure it doesn’t happen again. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to make it right.  

Thank you for your understanding.  

Best,  
[Your Name]  

PLAN: Identify the specific mistake to address in the email.  
PLAN: Draft a concise apology using a polite tone and clear responsibility.  
PLAN: Review the draft for clarity, then send it to the colleague.
